title: Merge agent-reviewed upstream sync PRs from a workflow
notes: The sync agent's own merge call is refused by its tool permissions, so a workflow now merges sync/upstream-* PRs when the agent's FINAL ACCEPT review covers the exact head (only clean merges of main, change records or standing-approval reference re-records after it), every required check passed there and main is in the head. It verifies the merge commit's first parent and escalates a mismatch like the daily sync.
